The readings "quoma", "fitrerun", "cabulu" and "λαχῶς" are partly visible and marked [?] where unclear. The first word "Singulares" is only partly visible. Marginal fragments at the left edge are only partly legible and their attachment to lines is approximate. Doubtful: "ꝛoλ" and "λε-" are Greek fragments read as far as visible; "ѵν." is uncertain. The line-end hyphens in "suppposito" follow the print as seen. "quacunq;" and "quoq;" are read from abbreviation marks that may be misread.
